mapper.sql: SELECT ug.id, ug.user_id AS member_id, ug.gym_id, ug.status, ug.joined_at AS requested_at, up.name AS member_name, up.contact AS member_phone, g.name AS gym_name FROM user_gym ug JOIN gym g ON g.id = ug.gym_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = ug.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE user_gym SET status = 'APPROVED', is_active = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE user_gym SET status = 'REJECTED', is_active = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_gym_request_log (user_id, gym_id, action, memo, actor_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{gymId}, #{action}, #{memo}, #{actorId})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.action, l.memo, l.created_at, cu.name AS actor_name FROM user_gym_request_log l LEFT JOIN crm_users cu ON cu.id = l.actor_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.gym_id = #{gymId} ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
